name: US Treasury Bills / T-Bills

yield.notes: Backed by US government. State income tax exempt. Federal ordinary income applies.

flags: Backed by full faith and credit of the US government
Treasury interest exempt from state income tax

startup_checklist: Open TreasuryDirect.gov account or use existing brokerage (Fidelity, Schwab, Vanguard)
Set up auto-rollover (reinvest at maturity) to reduce maintenance
Track maturity dates in calendar to avoid cash gaps
failure_modes: Cash flow gap when bills mature before reinvestment
Rate lock-in during Fed rate cut cycle
kill_criteria: APY drops below HYSA rate — roll to HYSA for equivalent safety with better liquidity
Emergency need requires liquidation before maturity
